verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions and track bills through natural language. It also advertises an AI-powered expense assistant. A community comment flags an incorrect answer in a 2023 Brex ChatGPT example, which tempers confidence about reliability but does not show the capability fails to work. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on which actions are supported via natural language and their limits, hands-on or independent corroboration of the MCP or assistant workflows, and detail on native in-app natural-language command support beyond expenses.
